lines: Your profile is yours to change now, right on the page.
Choose Edit profile, or Add a bio on a new profile. The dialog, built from the design system's own components, opens with what you have, ready at your name.
Your home church stays hidden from other members, unless you tick the box to show it.
Save changes, and your profile shows the new values at once, on phone and desktop.
Clear your name, write more than three hundred characters, or list a sixth goal, and the dialog names each one before anything is sent.
If a save is refused, or never answered, the dialog stays open and keeps everything you typed.
Only you can change your profile. A request for anyone else's is refused as forbidden, and nothing changes.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Next, slice nineteen point one: another member's profile.
That's slice eighteen point two. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
